text: Based on the tool output, the property did experience tree-cover loss of 67.7 ha in 2020, but this event occurred before the baseline date of December 31, 2020, and is therefore outside the claim interval. The assessment status is "NOT_DETECTED" for the period from 2021 to 2025, indicating no significant tree-cover loss during this time. Additionally, the JRC GFC2020 data shows that there was no forest cover in 2020, suggesting that the area may not have been classified as forest at the time of the loss. Therefore, while tree-cover loss did occur, it does not constitute deforestation within the defined claim interval.
